name: teaching-platform
description: 本地开发：根目录 npm 一键起前后端；数据库/Redis 见 RUN.txt

scripts.install:all: npm install --prefix backend && npm install --prefix frontend && npm install --prefix judge-worker
scripts.build: npm run build --prefix backend && npm run build --prefix frontend && npm run build --prefix judge-worker
scripts.dev: concurrently -c blue,green -n api,web "npm run dev --prefix backend" "npm run dev --prefix frontend"
scripts.dev:full: concurrently -c blue,green,magenta -n api,web,judge "npm run dev --prefix backend" "npm run dev --prefix frontend" "npm run dev --prefix judge-worker"
